column1: # v10 -- the contradictions the two audits could only see at the family level.
# Two mechanics had drifted apart from their own sibling strings:
#   * Trapping Interval was 陷阱间隔 in the bare entry and 设陷间隔 once wrapped
#     in a context sentence. "设陷" is an action, an *interval* cannot be an action.
#   * Rock Break is 击碎 everywhere (击碎条 / 击碎几率 / 每次击碎) except in the
#     four long "{Value} ... in {Context}" descriptors, which said 破碎 -- which
#     collides with Shatter, a different proc that really is 碎裂.
# Plus one lost line break (S4) and one CJK-CJK space (S6).
# ORDER MATTERS: swaps run top to bottom, so the Rock Break repairs must precede
# the generic Shatter one -- otherwise "岩石破碎时触发碎裂" (rock breaks, trigger
# Shatter) loses its first 破碎 to the Shatter rule and becomes 岩石碎裂时触发碎裂.
# --- Rock Break: unify on 击碎 (must run before the Shatter rule) -------------
